## What is still open

- Elad approved #1412 but wants one change before merge: an audit event per batch (id range, count, from/to KEK), not only the final summary, because assessors need per-batch traceability under 10.2 [3]. Avi will LGTM once that is in and wants it merged by Monday so the run can happen Tuesday night [3]. Your current job emits a single end-of-run audit record [1].
- Prod window is confirmed: Tue 24/11, 22:00–23:30 IL time, with Elad on call. The fallback is Thu 26/11, because the PCI change freeze starts Tue 1/12 [6].
- Shira needs two things by Wed 25/11, the day after the run: the export of the rotation job's audit log for the prod run and the signed change ticket. Screenshots won't be accepted by the assessor, Victor at Ardent [5]. The per-batch audit events feed directly into that export.
- The runbook's on-call field is still a placeholder. Elad is now named for the window [2][6].

## What you did

- Built the KEK rotation job for card tokens (PCI 3.7.4) and opened #1412 [1]. A staging dry run initially failed on 2,317 pre-2023 v1 tokens. You fixed it by mapping v1 explicitly to `vault-kek-2022`, and the rerun showed 0 failures out of 1,204,880 [1].
- Decided that the old keys `vault-kek-2025` and `vault-kek-2022` stay decrypt-only for 30 days and are not deleted. Deletion is a separate decision with Shira [1].
- Wrote the prod runbook `docs/runbooks/vault-kek-rotation.md`, including the failure and rollback section [2].
